description: Pinned provenance and rebuild invariants for the canonical resume baseline. This is the baseline subset of the canonical_map.json described in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-03-canonical-resume-tailoring-verifier-design.md. Mutable slots, text anchors, and per-slot edit budgets are NOT here yet; they belong to the patch-contract work that builds app/canonical.py, app/patch.py, and app/verify.py.

resume.pdf.note: Byte hash is provenance only, never a rebuild invariant: valid PDF build metadata and compression legitimately differ between compiles.

rebuild_invariants.tokenizer: pypdf extract_text per page, joined with newlines, whitespace collapsed to single spaces, split on whitespace
rebuild_invariants.note: Regenerated 2026-10-11 for the October 2026 base resume (new class with \project, Remote Orchestrator project, updated titles and skills, em dashes removed). The load-bearing invariant is that a rebuild matches THIS base PDF; token count is environment-qualified provenance.

provenance.harshsaw_tex_source: user-supplied 2026-10-10 (Oct10.tex), em dashes replaced with colons, commas, or parentheses
provenance.resume_cls_recovered_from: user-supplied resume_2.cls 2026-10-11, a superset of the 2026-08-03 class (adds \project, glyphtounicode, optional company link)
provenance.note: Any intentional future change to the base resume requires regenerating this file and reviewing the diff, not editing a hash in place.
